instructions_to_main_agent: Build a fully functional, highly interactive single page react web app for E-SPAK Puskesmas Palaran with Bahasa Indonesia terminology.
Implement role switching at top nav (Admin, Kepala Puskesmas, Pegawai, Penanggung Jawab Program) so evaluator can test all 4 perspectives seamlessly.
Target 1: Employee Competency Monitoring -> Target 40 JPL (Jam Pelajaran) + 8 Sertifikat per year. Include status indicators: BELUM MULAI, DALAM PROSES, MEMENUHI JPL, MEMENUHI JPL & SERTIFIKAT.

Target 2: SPM Health Program Indicators -> 12 SPM indicators (Ibu Hamil, Ibu Bersalin, Bayi Baru Lahir, Balita, Usia Pendidikan, Usia Produktif, Lansia, Hipertensi, Diabetes Melitus, ODGJ, TB, HIV). Color code Green (>=100%), Yellow (80-99%), Red (<80%).
Include Certificate Upload Modal with form fields: Judul Pelatihan, Penyelenggara, Tanggal, Jumlah JPL, File Upload simulation, and instant verification workflow for Admin.
Provide Executive Policy Brief generator with export preview modal and Early Warning System (EWS) notification panel.
Ensure every interactive button, input, tab, filter, and badge has a descriptive kebab-case data-testid attribute for automated testing.
Use clean health-tech styling with light gray background, navy/teal headers, high contrast text, crisp card borders, and smooth transitions.
